SectorState.title: SectorState
SectorState.description: Persistent space sector state for an authenticated commander, tracking flagship coordinates, layer, energy, turn counter, and galaxy seed.

name.description: Display name of the sector (1-60 chars).

galaxySeed.description: Deterministic baseline PRNG seed for the sector.

shipQ.description: Current flagship axial Q coordinate (-20 to 20).

shipR.description: Current flagship axial R coordinate (-20 to 20).

shipLayer.description: Current vertical layer index (0=Subsurface Core to 4=Deep Space).

lastEventLog.description: Latest commander action or sector event summary (0-500 chars).

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

HexCellSeed.title: HexCellSeed
HexCellSeed.description: Compact deterministic procedural voxel seed and DSL formula for a single hexagonal cell at (q, r, layerIndex), remembered forever and updated as game state evolves.

layerIndex.description: Vertical layer (0=Subsurface Core, 1=Surface Terrain, 2=Atmosphere, 3=Orbital Gravity Well, 4=Deep Space).

seed.description: Deterministic PRNG seed for hexagonal voxel synthesis.

proceduralFormula.description: Compact deterministic procedural DSL expression compiled in Kotlin to 3D hexagonal prism voxels (1-1200 chars).

gravityMass.description: Gravitational mass pull inducing curvature in surrounding hexes (0.0 to 15.0).

elevationOffset.description: Base height or depth offset for surface/subsurface strata (-10.0 to 10.0).

title.description: Generated name of the hex feature or object (1-80 chars).

loreSummary.description: Concise description of how this hex looks and behaves in game state (1-600 chars).

lastActionContext.description: Player action or prompt that generated or last evolved this hex (0-400 chars).

evolutionCount.description: Number of times this hex seed/code has been generated or updated (>= 1).

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/sectors/{sectorId}.description: Stores per-user persistent sector state and flagship telemetry.

/users/{userId}/hex_cells/{cellId}.description: Stores per-user procedural hex seeds and voxel formulas across all vertical space/atmosphere/surface layers.
